meta.units: mm, plan coords from floor_plan.json (x right, y down the page)
meta.source: Owner's sketch (2026-11-06): glass partition on both open sides (like the kitchen), panels hide at the hatched spots; two 1200 x 600 study tables along the Bedroom 3 wall.
meta.room: Study interior x 3425 (glass, living side) - 5750 (Bedroom 3 wall face), y 100 (facade face) - 3350 (glass, dining side).

partitions.label: Study glass partition (living side)
partitions.note: Living side, facade to the corner. 6 panels on 6 tracks; open, they all slide north and stack (~560 wide) against the facade wall between the living and study windows (hatched area on the sketch). Stops 75 short of the corner so it clears the south tracks.

partitions.label: Study glass partition (dining side)
partitions.note: Dining side, corner to the Bedroom 3 wall. 4 panels on 4 tracks; open, they slide east and stack (~630 wide) against the Bedroom 3 wall (hatched area on the sketch). Starts at the outer face of the west tracks so the corner is closed.

desk_note: Two 1200 x 600 study tables end to end along the Bedroom 3 wall, facing the wall; ~500 clear to the stacked south glass.

shelf.note: Suggested floating book shelf above the tables (not on the sketch).

study_desk.note: inside the study from the SW corner, towards the tables

study_glass.note: from the living / foyer side: both glass partitions
